definitions.explanation: A train heading away from Tokyo or a major city.
A particular part or passage in a text.

notes:
{下|くだ}り is the noun form of {下|くだ}る (to go down). It has three distinct meanings: physical descent, train direction, and a passage of text.

TRAIN TERMINOLOGY:
In Japanese rail, trains heading away from Tokyo (or the main city in a region) are {下|くだ}り, while trains heading toward Tokyo are {上|のぼ}り.
- {下|くだ}りの{電車|でんしゃ}: down-train
- {下|くだ}り{線|せん}: down-line (track)
- {上|のぼ}り: up-train (antonym)

TEXT PASSAGE:
Sense 3 refers to a section or passage of a book, letter, or speech. Often used with この{下|くだ}り (this passage) or ある{下|くだ}り (a certain passage).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {坂|さか}の{下|くだ}り: going downhill
- {山|やま}の{下|くだ}り: mountain descent
